description.short: Protect internal URLs and Connectors, and share them as expiring qURL links.
description.full: qURL makes infrastructure invisible by default. Protect an internal URL or a qURL Connector from Teams, grant a channel access to it, and mint time-limited links that only open network access for the person who redeems them. Administration, aliases, and revocation all happen in Teams; secrets are delivered in a personal chat, never in channel history.
